One chronologically-placed catalyst event for the frontend timeline.

LLM-cited raw_date by _parse_catalyst_date -- never LLM output.

quarter.description: One of 'Q1'..'Q4' for a specific quarter, 'H1'/'H2' when the source only supports half-year precision, or '' when only a bare year is known.

source.description: NCT id or SEC AccessionNumber this event is grounded in.
source.title: Source
